verdict.reasons: Core defect: The sub-text below the main 'AFP' logo on the packaging is illegible gibberish ('Dry Irrigation Tort') rather than the authentic 'Drip Irrigation Tape' seen in the reference, classifying it as fake text/branding. Additionally, the required technical evidence is flawed: the pressure gauge has its face turned fully toward the camera, showing a readable and fabricated pressure scale, whereas the specific instructions required the face to be angled away to prevent inventing a pressure rating. The drip tape geometry is also unrealistic, appearing as a suspended, rigid white ribbon that does not physically match how a thin flattened lateral lies on loose soil.
